Write a reply from Jonas Weber declining an invitation to speak at a conference on 12 March, because he will be travelling.
Limits: at most 90 words. The first line must be 'Dear Ms Albrecht,'. Thank her, say clearly that he cannot attend, mention the date, and offer an alternative: a later event or a colleague who could speak.
Answer with the reply only.

arguments.answer:
Dear Ms Albrecht,

Thank you very much for inviting me to speak at your conference. I am honoured that you thought of me.

Unfortunately, I cannot attend on 12 March, as I will be travelling at that time.

I would, however, be glad to speak at a later event if you have one planned. Alternatively, I can suggest a colleague who could speak on the same topic. Please let me know which you would prefer.

With best wishes,
Jonas Weber
